title: Eberouge Special: Koi to Mahou no Gakuen Seikatsu
native_title: エーベルージュ・スペシャル ～恋と魔法の学園生活～
overview: Eberouge Special: Koi to Mahō no Gakuen Seikatsu is a school life & love simulation game in the vein of Tokimeki Memorial, and an expanded and reworked version of Eberouge. This version of the game is significantly streamlined with the player starting as a new high school transfer student, removing the middle-school portion entirely and reducing the time limit to one year and nine months. Numerous new events have also been added, along with a new character, resulting in a much faster game with more events.
